---
title: "Bioinspired fish-like robots"
description: "Fish-like robots with learning-based locomotion control."
---

<span class="status">Hardware prototype validated in pool trials.</span>

Fish-like propulsion can be quiet and maneuverable. We study a robot fish driven by a reaction wheel.

*This platform supports our research program in [Bioinspired marine robotics](../research.qmd#bioinspired-robotics).*

## Demonstrated capabilities

Pool trials and system identification of heading dynamics via Parametric Weak-Form Sparse Regression (P-WSINDyc).
